dict.string: Notchium watches for new screenshots in your screenshot folder so you can add them to Shelf.
Notchium watches your Downloads folder to show download progress and completed files.
Notchium watches for new screenshots in your screenshot folder so you can add them to Shelf.
Notchium adds reminders to your chosen list when you use Quick Reminder.
Notchium reads your selected calendars to show upcoming events and meeting links around the notch.
Notchium captures app audio in memory to control each app’s volume and generate the Spotify waveform. Audio is never saved.
Notchium shows a small live preview in the notch when you open Mirror, so you can check yourself before a call. Nothing is recorded or saved.
Notchium checks whether a Focus is on so it can keep its own notifications quiet while you focus.
